name: learned
title: Learned general classification (similarity- and navigation-optimized prototype)

source.description: Fitted by schemes/learned (learned-scheme build) to 8000 works of the benchmark corpus (corpus.jsonl sha256 1027bf9d34928f470ed8b0d7b5ddc5c983fde49bc0cd33eaa162bbd1f830fea5, a subset of its 10000 works) on the k=20 kNN cosine graph (sha256 e5abcae63e02b68ddf11c150bed478a5f2d7760f68606566e1837e2cfeaaf073). Objective: normalized Dasgupta cost + 0.005 x expected navigation cost (per-branch cost 1 bits + log2 fan-out); 2-12 child classes, at most 4 levels, leaf classes of at least 5 works; seed 20261010. Labels: written by hand from each class's c-TF-IDF terms and most central titles; the terms are the class vocabulary (source ctfidf).
